svg.title: Blueprint sheet 17, the chain: the good of all is multiplied, not added up. After Stefano Zamagni, with Luigino Bruni

g.text: THE GOOD OF ALL IS MULTIPLIED
not added up: leave anyone at nothing, and it comes to nothing
the old saying: a chain is only as strong as its weakest link.
take from one, give more to
another, and the sum still grows.
a living blueprint for a world
